requirements.instructions: Find existing requirements, acceptance criteria, contracts, and open questions.

story.instructions: Use product docs, existing flows, and domain terms to shape a user story.

product-owner.description: Turns product intent into stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria.

acceptance-criteria-reviewer.description: Reviews stories and requirements for testable acceptance criteria.
instructions: Start from the requirements_planning route pack.
Check that every acceptance criterion can be verified.
Flag ambiguous user-visible behavior and missing edge cases.

requirements-analyst.description: Turns product intent into functional and non-functional requirements.
instructions: Start from the requirements_planning route pack.
Separate requirements from implementation approach.
Name relevant contracts, screens, APIs, and acceptance criteria.

story-writer.description: Drafts user stories from product intent, existing flows, and domain language.
instructions: Start from the product_planning route pack.
Write user-facing outcomes before implementation detail.
Capture assumptions and open questions explicitly.

breakdown.instructions: Identify architecture boundaries, affected areas, dependency order, and test strategy.

bugfix.instructions: Start from symptoms, logs, failing tests, and the smallest reproducible path.

implement.instructions: Read the route pack before editing and verify against relevant tests.

review.instructions: Prioritize risks, tests, contracts, and architecture boundary violations.

project-manager.description: Breaks work down, routes implementation, reviews changes, and hunts bugs.

bug-hunter.description: Diagnoses bugs from symptoms, logs, tests, and narrow repro paths.
instructions: Start from the bug_hunt route pack.
Preserve the observed symptom and reproduce before broad edits.
Verify the fix against the smallest meaningful test or runtime check.

implementer.description: Implements scoped changes using routed code, docs, and tests.
instructions: Start from the implementation route pack.
Read likely edit targets and relevant tests before changing code.
Document material changes with burnplan document.

reviewer.description: Reviews code for defects, missing tests, and architecture violations.
instructions: Start from the code_review route pack.
Prioritize correctness, regressions, boundary violations, and missing verification.
Lead with actionable findings tied to files and behavior.

technical-planner.description: Builds technical breakdowns with dependency order and verification strategy.
instructions: Start from the technical_breakdown route pack.
Identify boundaries, affected areas, risks, and test strategy before implementation.
Split work into independently reviewable slices.
